name: colmena-ai
description: TypeScript bindings for Colmena LLM and DAG Engine

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --features node --cargo-cwd src/libs/colmena --cargo-name colmena --cargo-flags="--lib" && tsc -p ts/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --features node --cargo-cwd src/libs/colmena --cargo-name colmena --cargo-flags="--lib" && tsc -p ts/tsconfig.json
